With a robust nursing background and specialized training in medical aesthetics, I aim to blend clinical expertise with a gentle, patient-centered approach to aesthetic treatments. I am honored to be part of your self-care journey and can't wait to help you look and feel your very best with specialized services, including Botox and lip filler. Mission I created The Olive Branch Med Spa with a simple philosophy in mind: every patient deserves an experience rooted in Peace, Renewal, and Vitality. These principles shape the environment I've built and the care I provide through our various spa services. At The Olive Branch, we are committed to delivering safe, medical-grade aesthetic treatments, including popular options like Botox and lip filler, through a personalized and compassionate approach. Aesthetics is treated as a pathway to restored confidence, meaningful self-care, and holistic well-being. Through advanced skill, education, and authentic connection, patients are supported in looking and feeling their very best. This is my olive branch I offer to you—a med spa where you can feel supported, cared for, and confident in your own skin. Services At The Olive Branch Med Spa, I offer a curated selection of aesthetic treatments designed to enhance natural beauty and support long-term skin health. Neurotoxins like Botox, Dysport and Daxxify are utilized to soften fine lines and wrinkles for a smoother, refreshed appearance, while dermal filler helps restore or enhance facial volume to achieve balanced, youthful contours. For overall skin renewal, VI Peel exfoliates and stimulates collagen production to improve texture, tone, and complexion. Each of our spa services is tailored to your unique needs, ensuring subtle, natural-looking results that help you feel confident and revitalized. I also offer customized IV hydration and vitamin injections including B12, glutathione and NAD+ to help rejuvenate and restore energy. The Olive Branch Skin Renewal Programs Begin Your Skin Renewal Journey A curated treatment plan tailored specifically to you, guiding your skin through a structured journey of renewal, refinement, and restoration. Your skin, reimagined through regenerative care. The Wedding Glow Program A 12-week pre-event skin transformation designed for brides and others prepping for special occasions. Focused on luminous, smooth, camera-ready skin through structured regenerative care. Renewal Program Advanced skin rejuvenation for visible signs of aging, including fine lines, texture changes, and pigmentation. Designed to restore firmness, clarity, and overall skin health. Preservation Program Preventative care for younger patients focused on maintaining collagen, preventing early aging, and supporting long-term skin vitality. Your skin, restored. Your beauty, naturally refined. Every program begins with a personalized consultation so we can design the right regenerative plan for your skin goals. Schedule Your Consultation Treat hair loss at the cellular level Introducing Xtressé Hair Growth Gummies A breakthrough nutritional supplement designed to support hair follicle health on a cellular level. Developed by a leading panel of dermatologists and hair restoration experts, Xtressé ™ is powered by a modern, proprietary X3-Bioactive™ blend born from regenerative medicine. It consists of scientifically proven plant-based extracts and nutraceuticals that are not commonly found in existing hair supplements. What is Xtressé Xtressé is a biotin-free hair growth gummy supplement featuring a proprietary X3-BioActive Blend™ of plant extracts (saw palmetto, pumpkin seed, pea sprout, ashwagandha, turmeric, horsetail) and regenerative compounds (NAD+, taurine) to target inflammation, oxidative stress, and hormonal imbalances causing thinning hair, aiming for thicker, stronger hair by supporting follicle health from within, with results often seen in 8-12 weeks Patient Experiences Contact me Better yet, come see me in person!
